Experience supporting ML systems in production: feature engineering, training datasets, feature stores, or model-serving data flows

Clear communication with engineers, data scientists, and business partners alike

Experience with analytics instrumentation tooling or tracking-plan governance

Your work directly shapes how millions of makers discover, design, and create

You'll have real ownership of platform architecture and a strong voice in technical direction

Design, build, and operate scalable batch and streaming pipelines on AWS using Airflow (MWAA), Glue, Kafka, S3, and Redshift

Partner with ML engineers to build feature pipelines and a batch plus low-latency feature store (for example, Redshift or S3 to DynamoDB) for real-time serving

Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and on-call practices, and mentor other engineers

Clear communication with engineers, data scientists, and business partners alike

Experience with data lake table formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) or Redshift data sharing

Your work directly shapes how millions of makers discover, design, and create
You'll help build the data backbone for Cricut's AI and personalization roadmap
You'll have real ownership of platform architecture and a strong voice in technical direction
You'll join a collaborative team that values craft, curiosity, and impact
